title: Your Career Is a Portfolio, Not a Ladder
author: Sample Writer
whyPicked: it reframes career switches as compounding, not starting over
hook: Why do the people with the messiest CVs keep landing the most interesting roles?
thesis: Careers now reward a portfolio of rare skill combinations, not years spent climbing one ladder.

ideas.label: Ladders broke
ideas.headline: The ladder assumed nothing would change
ideas.body: Promotion paths were built for stable industries. When roles shift every few years, seniority in one track loses value fast.

ideas.label: Stack rare combos
ideas.headline: Value comes from combinations
ideas.body: Being top 25% in two or three areas that rarely overlap beats being top 1% in one crowded field.

ideas.label: Deep and broad
ideas.headline: The rare spot is deep and broad
ideas.body: Most people grow along one axis. The valuable corner combines real depth with range.

ideas.label: Story is the glue
ideas.headline: Your story connects the dots
ideas.body: A non-linear path only reads as strength when you can explain the thread running through it.

takeaway: Stop asking what the next rung is. Ask which new skill makes your existing ones rarer, then tell that story out loud.

narration.intro: Here's a ninety second read of Your Career Is a Portfolio, Not a Ladder.
narration.hook: Why do people with messy CVs keep landing the most interesting roles?
narration.thesis: The author's answer: careers now reward rare combinations of skills, not years spent climbing one ladder.
narration.idea0: The ladder was built for a world that stayed still. When roles shift every few years, seniority in one track loses value fast. A portfolio of bets keeps compounding.
narration.idea1: So value comes from combinations. Pick a core skill, add one next to it, and own the place where they overlap.
narration.idea2: Picture two axes, depth and breadth. Most people grow along one. The rare and valuable corner is deep and broad at the same time.
narration.idea3: And your story is the glue. Try a role, learn the skill, tell the story, and that story wins you the next bet.
narration.map: Put together: ladders broke, combinations win, depth plus range is rare, and your story connects it all.
narration.takeaway: So stop asking what the next rung is. Ask which new skill makes your existing ones rarer, then say that story out loud.
narration.outro: Read the full piece for the details.
